item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] FAA says it hired more than 2,000 'gamers' to train as air traffic controllers
item.description: The Federal Aviation Administration is following up on a campaign in April that targeted gamers as air traffic controllers.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Bob Iger, Josh Kushner to buy Lakers in historic $12.5 billion deal
item.description: Josh Kushner and Bob Iger have agreed to buy the Lakers for $12.5 billion, setting a new record for a U.S. professional sports team sale.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Neighbors complain about noise from Universal’s ‘Fast & Furious’ ride
item.description: Universal Studios Hollywood plans new sound barriers around its “Fast & Furious” coaster after neighbors complained about screaming during ride testing.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Manhattan entrepreneur builds pizza business out of compact car
item.description: A New Yorker is serving stone-fired pizzas from the trunk of a two-seater car, turning his mobile “Pizza Pod” into a hit at events and parties.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Millions of adults in the US should be taking blood pressure-lowering medication
item.description: Nearly 1 in 3 adults in the United States with untreated high blood pressure would benefit from treatment and are not getting it, according to a new study.
